metadata.description: lsdsk delivered as a single Claude Code plugin: a skill to inspect and diagnose storage topology, link speeds and disk health on Linux and Windows.

plugins.name: lsdsk
plugins.description: Install and use lsdsk: group disks by controller, compare every link against what both ends could do, read SMART wear and error counters, and decide whether a slow link is a fault, a better slot, or a mainboard limit.
